distinctions.operational_transactional: Communication necessary to fulfill a requested service/relationship.
distinctions.marketing_nurture: Communication intended to cultivate, promote, solicit, or maintain engagement beyond the immediate transaction.

rules: Website intake is not blanket marketing consent.
Consent must capture purpose/topic where applicable, channel, source, timestamp, opt-out, and suppression.
Operational communications may use transactional purpose only where semantics fit.
Marketing/nurture Journey entry requires appropriate consent evidence.
dataverse_interaction: Journeys consent entities/purposes are Microsoft-native consent store; Contact remains enterprise identity.
